data.description: 【斯卡蒂 · 港口晨雾】伊比利亚冷雾弥漫的破旧港口旁，身着黑色深海猎人风衣的斯卡蒂单手倚在生锈的集装箱边，孤身远眺汹涌翻滚的深海。海风吹拂着她银白色的及膝长发，深红色的眼眸平静却藏着无尽的孤寂——「海浪的声音很吵，那些怪物的低语从未停止……博士，离我远一点，我的身边只有危险。」
data.promptProse: At the foggy Iberian harbor, Skadi braces one hand on a rusted shipping container and watches the dark sea, wind lifting her black hunter trench-coat collar above the red-accented bodysuit. The medium-wide view includes container ribs beside her and the dock extending toward water through mist. Soft dawn light catches rust edges and silver hair, reflecting faintly across the restless sea while the container's sheltered side remains dark.
data.title: 斯卡蒂 · 港口晨雾
